metadata.title: A solution to a problem of Ghomi and Raffaelli on closed asymptotic curves
metadata.abstract: We construct a smooth embedded open annulus in Euclidean three-space with strictly negative Gaussian curvature and injective Gauss map that contains a simple closed asymptotic curve of zero normal self-linking. This gives an affirmative answer to Problem 1.1 of Ghomi and Raffaelli. The construction starts with two simple planar curves whose tangent vectors are positive multiples of one another. Their mixed integral is made zero by rounding a pair of polygons with one free length parameter.
metadata.comment: 13 pages. Comments and suggestions are welcome

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 闭 asymptotic curve 的负曲率 annulus 构造
analysis.workSummary: 构造 R³ 中严格负 Gauss 曲率、Gauss 映射单射的光滑嵌入开 annulus，含零 normal self-linking 的简单闭 asymptotic curve；由平面曲线与 polygon rounding 调节 mixed integral。
analysis.breakthrough: 肯定回答 Ghomi–Raffaelli 的开放问题。
analysis.limitations: 对象为开 annulus，不能替换为闭曲面或完整嵌入曲面。
analysis.priorityReason: 肯定回答 Ghomi–Raffaelli 的开放问题。
